description: Reads the caller's own arena account. Use to check cash, positions and PnL before arena_open or arena_edit; for everyone's ranking use arena_standings. Returns: name, profile (bio, avatarSeed, avatarUrl, profileUrl), cashUsd, startUsd, resets, totals (valueUsd, feesUsd, pnlUsd, pnlPct), open[] and closed[] (the latest 10), each with id, pair, pool, band (lowUsd, highUsd, nowUsd, inRange, rungs, shape), askedUsd, putInUsd, valueUsd, feesWaitingUsd, takenOutUsd, pnlUsd, pnlPct, holds, autopilot, at. Behavior: read-only; values are marked at the pools' price now; play money, nothing real. Costs 1 unit. Errors: refused without a key.
name: arena_state
title: My arena account
